# Town of Brownington municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 4; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists three Brownington Selectboard members: Byron Burdick, Mike Glodgett, and Marilyn Martinez (Chair).
Town of Brownington official website, Select Board page: lists Mike Glodgett (term expires 2027), Marilyn Martinez, Chairman (term expires 2028), and Byron Burdick (term expires 2029).

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Cheryl Galipeau as Town Clerk of Brownington and as Town Treasurer of Brownington. The town's website contact page names only the office; no official source names any other holder.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Cheryl Galipeau as Town Clerk of Brownington and as Town Treasurer of Brownington.

Town of Brownington, 2026 Annual Town Meeting Warning (published on the town website): warns election of a Moderator. No official source publishes the holder's name, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.
Town of Brownington official website, Listers page: lists Larry Chase (term expires 2027), Roger Patenaude (term expires 2028), and Larry Faust (term expires 2029) as Listers.
Town of Brownington official website, Auditors page: lists Barbara Thompson (term expires 2027), Kim Hastings (term expires 2028), and Beth Martin (term expires 2029) as Auditors.
Town of Brownington official website, Constables page: lists Cameron Falconer as Town First Constable (term expires 2028).
Town of Brownington official website, Constables page: lists Renee Falconer as Town Second Constable (term expires 2028).

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a grand juror at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a town agent at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Brownington justices of the peace: Armand Brunelle, Larry Chase, Larry Faust, Andrew Swett, and Michael Glodgett.
Town of Brownington official website, Justices of the Peace page: names the same five justices of the peace.
